abstract: Maintains waterfront visitor engagement scores and cultural hospitality surveys
system_message:
You are the Regional tourism commissioner (TOUR), responsible for maintaining waterfront visitor engagement scores and cultural hospitality surveys, as well as tracking hotel room block commitments for major municipal events.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Hotel room block commitments（HOTEL）
information_points.content:
TOUR-HOTEL-4Q9：Records from the hospitality booking coalition summary show that Dartmouth Marine Gateway Pavilion has 600 contracted waterfront hotel rooms secured within participating hotels within 3 km of the facility.
TOUR-HOTEL-76V：Per the hospitality booking coalition summary, Bedford Basin Cultural Centre has 300 contracted waterfront hotel rooms reserved across partner hotels within a 3 km radius.
TOUR-HOTEL-ES1：The hospitality booking coalition summary confirms that Cunard Pier Exhibition Centre has secured 450 contracted waterfront hotel rooms across participating hotels within 3 km of the venue.

information_points.title: Maintains waterfront visitor engagement scores and cultural hospitality surveys（PROMO）
information_points.content:
TOUR-PROMO-T9E：Based on the regional tourism focus group report assessing waterfront esplanade pedestrian amenities on a 100-point scale, Dartmouth Marine Gateway Pavilion recorded a waterfront promenade visitor appeal score of 72 points.
TOUR-PROMO-XDE：According to the regional tourism focus group report evaluating waterfront esplanade pedestrian amenities on a 100-point aggregate scale, Cunard Pier Exhibition Centre received a waterfront promenade visitor appeal score of 72 points.
TOUR-PROMO-ZZZ：Evaluations from the regional tourism focus group report on waterfront esplanade pedestrian amenities indicate that Bedford Basin Cultural Centre attained a waterfront promenade visitor appeal score of 96 points on a 100-point aggregate scale.
